# KiddyTube Android install

## Flutter (latest, recommended)

Sideload on a 64-bit Android phone, tablet, or TV (Android 7.0+). Built from `polish/flutter-ios-next` (catalog seed v50).

- **[Download Flutter APK](KiddyTube-flutter-0.1.0.apk)** (22 MB, version 0.1.0)
- Phone-friendly page: [index.html](index.html)

Package ID: `ae.kiddytube.kiddytube` (installs next to the older Kotlin app, which uses `ae.kiddytube.app`).

## Older Kotlin app (main)

- **[Download Kotlin APK](KiddyTube-2.1.0.apk)** (13 MB, version 2.1.0)

## On your phone

1. Open the APK link in Chrome
2. Allow installs from the browser if Android asks
3. Tap **Install**, then open **KiddyTube**

These are sideload builds (not from Play Store). Parent PIN: `2580`.
